desc.zh: 山社乡里的神职之女，以神乐事神、以祓词退魔。铃响处，神使应召而至。
desc.en: Holy maidens of Nippon's mountain shrines, banishing demons with kagura and sacred chants. When their bells ring, the Divine Envoy answers.

story.zh: 在尼朋，巫女的存在比大名的家纹更古老：史传有以鬼道事神、凭神谕号令诸部的女王，圣日朝廷的祭祀里也有终身侍神的斋王。权柄归于武士领主之后，她们退出庙堂，退回山社乡里，守着一方鸟居与一枚神乐铃过活。神乐之舞起于天岩户前的踏桶之响——旋至极处，舞者之身即为依代，神明降于其上，这便是巫女最古老的本事。乱世来临，社殿焚毁，妖物与邪祟趁乱横行；她们或坚守神社寸土不让，或化作行游列国的游方巫女，一路禊祓、封魔、退治邪祟。
story.en: In Nippon, the miko are older than the crests of the daimyo. The histories tell of a queen who served the gods through the ways of spirits and commanded the clans by oracle, and of the consecrated princesses who served the gods for life in the rites of the court of the Holy Sun. When power passed to the samurai lords, the miko withdrew from the halls of state, back to the mountain shrines and villages, keeping one torii and one kagura bell to live by. The kagura dance was born of the thunder of the stamping tub before the Heavenly Rock Cave: whirled to its utmost, the dancer's own body becomes the yorishiro, and the god descends upon it; that is the most ancient of the miko's arts. Now the age of strife is come: shrine halls burn, and monsters and evil spirits run wild in the disorder. Some hold their shrine ground and yield not an inch; others go out as wandering miko over all the provinces, purifying with the rites, sealing demons, and putting evil spirits down along the way.

v.zh: 玉海舰队、山陽氏与奥本氏开局即可招募；其余震旦派系需先攻占大社并完成「尼朋的祭仪」任务。下列建筑任一即可招募：岸上「稻荷神社」链 2 级「稻荷大社」（定居点 3 级）、旗舰「舰上稻荷社」链 III 行「船上稻荷本社」、地标「灵道社殿」2 级「灵道本殿」（定居点 2 级）
v.en: Available from the start to the Jade Sea Fleet and the Sanyo and Okumoto Clans; other Cathay factions must first take the Great Shrine and complete "The Rites of Nippon". Any one of these buildings lets you recruit her: the Inari Grand Shrine (tier 2 of the Inari Shrine chain, settlement level 3), the Shipboard Inari Main Shrine (row III of the flagship's Shipboard Inari Shrine chain) or the Great Shrine Inner Sanctuary (tier 2 of the Great Shrine landmark, settlement level 2)

v.zh: 无全局上限；同时在役名额由建筑提供：「稻荷大社」「船上稻荷本社」各 +1，升到「灵兽神宫」（稻荷神社链 3 级，定居点 5 级）「麟栖神宫」（舰上稻荷社链 V 行）各 +2，「灵道本殿」+1；各处叠加，满配 +5
v.en: No overall cap; how many can serve at once depends on buildings. The Inari Grand Shrine and the Shipboard Inari Main Shrine give +1 each, rising to +2 each at the Divine Beast Sanctuary (tier 3 of the Inari Shrine chain, settlement level 5) and the Kirin Roost Sanctuary (row V of the Shipboard Inari Shrine chain); the Great Shrine Inner Sanctuary adds +1. They stack, up to +5

note.zh: 只列本 mod 原创的技能线。原版复用的战役行动线不列。巫女法系与纱代共用，法术数值见上面的技能表。

sub.zh: 这一类巫女的职业修行：祭祀、御守、卜占、供养神使。起点「依代」8 级解锁，之后四格可各自点出，「注連縄」须四格全点；中间两格与纱代共用。
sub.en: The calling every miko shares: rites, charms, divination and offerings to the divine envoys. Yorishiro opens at rank 8; the next four can be taken in any order and Shimenawa needs all four. Two of the middle skills are shared with Sayo.

sub.zh: 六个法术与一个学派被动。法术每格三级：一级解锁基础施法，二级解锁增幅并冷却 −30%，三级冷却 −50%、增幅失误几率 −15%、魔风消耗降低；破魔矢基础版 1 级即会，节点只有后两级。
sub.en: Six spells and a lore passive. Each spell has three levels: the first unlocks it, the second adds the overcast and cuts the cooldown by 30%, the third cuts it by 50%, lowers the overcast's miscast chance by 15% and trims the Winds of Magic cost. Hamaya's base spell comes free at rank 1, so its node holds only the last two levels.

sub.zh: 两条两级侧支：一条施法精通，一条物理抗性。
sub.en: Two two-level side skills: one for spell mastery, one for physical resistance.
